entries.Translated: $t = 开怪倒计时 - 例如 PT 27 / ET 13:37

entries.Original: For more detailed loot tracking take a look at the plugin TrackyTack~
entries.Translated: 如需更详细的战利品追踪，请查看插件 TrackyTack~

entries.Original: Show Timer On Server Info Bar
entries.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示计时器

entries.Original: Display the pot FATE timer in the server info bar. Click the timer to place a flag on the map.
entries.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示特殊FATE计时器。点击计时器可在地图上放置标记。

entries.Original:
Anonymously provide data for instance history.
This data can't be tied to you in any way and everyone benefits!
entries.Translated:
匿名提供副本历史数据。
此数据无法与你关联，且人人受益！

resources.Original: If you wish to learn more about Forked Tower or would like to participate in an organized group, it's encouraged to join one of the following Discord servers for your respective region.
resources.Translated: 如果你想了解更多关于分叉塔的信息，或希望参与有组织的团队，建议加入你所在区域的以下Discord服务器之一。

resources.Original: Please be aware that attempting to join Forked Tower as an individual player is highly discouraged. This means to stand on the tower platform during the prerequisite weather conditions, in addition to offering any amount of ciphers for entry during this period.
resources.Translated: 请注意，强烈不建议以个人身份尝试加入分叉塔。这意味着需要在先决天气条件下站在塔平台上，并在此期间提供任意数量的密码以供进入。

resources.Original: Copy tracker instance id to clipboard.
resources.Translated: 复制追踪实例 ID 到剪贴板。

resources.Original: Shout will be available 20s after spawn.
Adds a small indicator "(active)" to the tab name if tower is active.
resources.Translated: 当高塔激活时，在标签名后添加一个小标记“(激活)”。

resources.Original: Return to Central Point and talk to Ejika Tsunjika or Krile (opposite you picked)
resources.Translated: 返回中点，与Ejika Tsunjika或Krile（与你所选相反的一方）对话

resources.Original: Choose between Krile's path (sealing) or that of Ejika Tsunjika (destruction)
resources.Translated: 在Krile的路线（封印）与Ejika Tsunjika的路线（灭亡）之间选择

resources.Original: Talk again to Krile (a few cutscenes will play)
resources.Translated: 再次与Krile对话（将播放几段过场动画）

resources.Original: Go in the Board Room and talk again to Krile
resources.Translated: 进入委员长办公室，再次与Krile对话

resources.Original: Proceed into the Headquarters Entrance (Teleport next to you)
resources.Translated: 进入总部塔入口（传送至你旁边）

resources.Original: Head to The Aetherbridge Foundation and talk again to Krile
resources.Translated: 前往魔力桥基，再次与Krile对话

resources.Original: Head to The Eastern Columns and talk to Krile
resources.Translated: 前往东部魔力桥脚，与Krile对话

resources.Original: Unable to place fairy markers on map
resources.Translated: 无法在地图上放置小仙女标记
正在从追踪中移除不活跃的小仙女。

resources.Original: Automatically display pot treasure locations on the map when you have a pot following you.
resources.Translated: 当有罐子跟随你时，自动在地图上显示罐子宝物位置。

resources.Original: Disabling this option will remove time element from the shout message.
resources.Translated: 禁用此选项将从喊话消息中移除时间元素。

resources.Original: Only shows the low level bunny fates for Pagos and Pyros.
resources.Translated: 仅显示帕戈斯和皮罗斯的低等级兔子FATE。

resources.Original: Forked Tower hasn't been seen yet.
Draws a circle if the player is near a coffer location.
resources.Translated: 当玩家靠近宝箱位置时绘制一个圆圈。

resources.Original: Unable to place fairy markers on minimap
resources.Translated: 无法在小地图上放置妖精标记

resources.Original: This quest unlocks additional capacity for the logos manipulator.
resources.Translated: 此任务可解锁文理操纵者的额外容量。

resources.Original: The following information is only for Forked Tower Blood, and Forked Tower Magic Extreme!
resources.Translated: 以下信息仅适用于分叉塔血战和分叉塔魔法极难度！

resources.Original: Forked Tower Magic Normal is a version that spawns in open instances, the extreme version must be queued with an Alliance Raid.
resources.Translated: 分叉塔魔法普通难度是在开放副本中生成的版本，极难度必须通过团队任务排队进入。

resources.Original: Unable to place all markers on map
resources.Translated: 无法在地图上放置所有标记

resources.Original: Use the Logos Manipulator and select the Paralyze L logogram and extract the mneme
resources.Translated: 使用文理操纵者，选择麻痹L的文理技能并提取记忆

resources.Original: Proceed to Northeastern Ice Needles and interact with the confluence
resources.Translated: 前往冰针东北，与传送魔法研究所互动

resources.Original: Proceed to The Living Foundry and talk to Krile
resources.Translated: 前往实验魔器工房，与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Proceed to The Surgate Town House and interact with the Promising Scrap
resources.Translated: 前往萨盖特别墅遗迹，与有希望的废料互动

resources.Original: Proceed to The Firing Chamber and interact with the confluence
resources.Translated: 前往耐热实验场，与传送魔法研究所互动

resources.Original: You are not in Eureka, this command is unavailable.
resources.Translated: 你不在优雷卡，此命令不可用。

resources.Original: You can also speak with Gerolt any time after first speaking to Krile to unlock Eureka Pagos weapon enhancement.
resources.Translated: 首次与可露儿对话后，随时可与盖罗尔特对话解锁优雷卡恒冰之地的武器强化。

resources.Original: You aren't in the occult territory, this window is not of any use.
resources.Translated: 你不在神秘领域内，此窗口无用。

resources.Original: Adds the coffer locations on entry of eureka.
resources.Translated: 进入优雷卡时添加宝箱位置。

resources.Original: This plugin uploads anonymized instance data. For more information on the exact data collected please see the upload tab in the configuration menu. You can opt out of any and all forms of data collection.
resources.Translated: 本插件会上传匿名实例数据。有关所收集具体数据的更多信息，请参阅配置菜单中的上传标签页。你可以选择退出任何及所有形式的数据收集。

resources.Original: Awaiting next fate before searching again ...
resources.Translated: 等待下一个 FATE 后再搜索……

resources.Original: Automatic markers are active, switching not possible.
resources.Translated: 自动标记已启用，无法切换。

resources.Original: Please open your challenge log in the 'Field Operations' category.
resources.Translated: 请在“特殊场景探索”分类中打开你的挑战日志。

resources.Original: Locate the Depleted Aetherial Stream at The Val River Belly
resources.Translated: 在瓦尔河谷找到枯竭的以太流

resources.Original: Want to join a Forked Tower run?
resources.Translated: 想加入分叉塔的攻略队伍吗？

resources.Original: Mobs will spawn around and inside the building during nighttime and as such it is recommended to do this during daytime (6am to 6pm ET).
resources.Translated: 夜间建筑周围及内部会刷新怪物，因此建议在白天（艾欧泽亚时间 6:00 至 18:00）进行。

resources.Original: You must obtain a Protean Crystal from a normal monster.
resources.Translated: 你必须从普通怪物身上获得变形晶石。

resources.Original: You cannot exchange Anemos Crystals for Protean Crystals until you finish this quest.
resources.Translated: 完成此任务前，你无法将风之晶石兑换为变形晶石。

resources.Original: Locate the magicite at The Eastern Edge
Interact with it again in almost the same location
resources.Translated: 在几乎相同的位置再次与其交互

resources.Original: Locate the Depleted Aetherial Stream at The Cones (upper level on a raised grassy hill)
resources.Translated: 在松塔林找到枯竭的以太流（上层隆起的草坡上）

resources.Original: Tracking for fairies needs to be reset, please go to all listed locations to update.
resources.Translated: 妖精追踪需要重置，请前往所有列出的位置进行更新。
无法检测到优雷卡进度。

resources.Original: Proceed to the The Orchard below the cliff and interact with the Confluence
resources.Translated: 前往悬崖下方的高树果林并与传送魔法研究所交互

resources.Original:
Refreshing is necessary as the game has to request updated progress from the server.
A cooldown of 5s applies after each use.
resources.Translated:
需要刷新，因为游戏必须向服务器请求更新进度。
每次使用后有5秒冷却时间。

resources.Original: Proceed inside the Early Natural History Society Observatory and interact with the Confluence
resources.Translated: 进入早期博物学协会天文台并与传送魔法研究所交互

resources.Original: This quest unlocks The Baldesion Arsenal.
resources.Translated: 此任务将解锁兵器演示层。

resources.Original: Speak with the Expedition Scholar after finishing this quest.
resources.Translated: 完成此任务后与远征知识神像对话。

resources.Original: Proceed to the Uncanny Valley and interact with the Confluence
resources.Translated: 前往奇怪谷并与传送魔法研究所互动

resources.Original: Proceed to the Aethernet Control and interact with the Aethernet Relay
resources.Translated: 前往传送技术管理室并与传送中继器互动

resources.Original: Interact with the Aethernet Relay again and trade in 99 Anemos Crystals.
resources.Translated: 再次与传送中继器互动并上交99个风之水晶。
与可露儿和杰罗特对话

resources.Original: Proceed to The Western Columns and talk again to Krile
resources.Translated: 前往西部魔力桥脚并再次与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Proceed to The West Val River Bank
Walk up the large column to find the Pooled Aether
resources.Translated: 登上大石柱寻找汇聚的以太

resources.Original: Return to The Western Columns and talk to Krile
resources.Translated: 返回西部魔力桥脚并与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Unable to place all markers on minimap
resources.Translated: 无法在小地图上放置所有标记

resources.Original: Where can I join an organized run? (Click name)
resources.Translated: 在哪里可以参加有组织的活动？（点击名称）

resources.Original: Proceed to the The Val River Swale near the waterfall and interact with the Confluence
resources.Translated: 前往瀑布附近的瓦尔河流域并与传送魔法研究所互动

resources.Original: Head north to The East Val River Bank to find the Pooled Aether
resources.Translated: 向北前往瓦尔河东岸寻找汇聚的以太

resources.Original: Proceed east to The Eastern Columns and talk to Krile again
resources.Translated: 向东前往东部魔力桥脚，再次与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Talk to Krile at the The Western Columns
resources.Translated: 在西部魔力桥脚与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Return to The Eastern Columns and talk to Krile
resources.Translated: 返回东部魔力桥脚与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Remove spotted treasure and carrots, after X Seconds of being unseen, so that notifications can reappear.
resources.Translated: 在 X 秒内未被发现后，移除已发现的宝物和胡萝卜，以便通知可以再次出现。

resources.Original: Return to the The Central Columns and talk to Krile
resources.Translated: 返回中央魔力桥脚与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Proceed south to The Val River Source and find the Pooled Aether
resources.Translated: 向南前往瓦尔河源流寻找汇聚的以太

resources.Original: Proceed to The Central Columns and talk again to Krile
resources.Translated: 前往中央魔力桥脚，再次与可露儿对话

resources.Original: You've found a new chest location
resources.Translated: 你发现了一个新的宝箱位置

resources.Original: Please consider sending the following information to the developer:
resources.Translated: 请考虑将以下信息发送给开发者：

resources.Original: (Please do not use the feedback function to send this)
resources.Translated: （请勿使用反馈功能发送此内容）

resources.Original: Locate the aether column at The Fumarole
resources.Translated: 在地脉喷口找到以太柱

resources.Original: Proceed to The Cavern of the Second Cant and interact with the confluence
resources.Translated: 前往第二歌洞窟并与传送魔法研究所互动

resources.Original: Proceed to East Flamerock and interact with the confluence
resources.Translated: 前往火岩溶洞东侧并与传送魔法研究所互动

resources.Original: Proceed to The Living Foundry and talk to Krile
resources.Translated: 前往实验魔器工房，与可露儿对话

resources.Original: Talk to Krile (a few cutscenes will play)
resources.Translated: 与可露儿对话（将播放几段过场动画）

resources.Original: Proceed to West Flamerock and interact with the confluence
resources.Translated: 前往火岩溶洞西侧并与传送魔法研究所互动
在浏览器中打开追踪器
